artworks.title: Sir Anthony Shirley
artworks.description: The image features a bust-length portrait of an individual facing forward with a slightly turned to the right position. The person has distinct facial features, a prominent nose, and facial hair with a full beard and mustache. The individual's hair is curly and styled with volume. He is depicted wearing a formal garment with a high, ornate ruff collar and armor. The background includes a decorative pattern, an oval frame, and a circular inscription within the border.

artworks.title: Sir Anthony Shirley, Traveler and Ambassador to Persia
artworks.artist: Dominicus Custos after Aegidius Sadeler II
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man with curly hair, a beard, mustache, and distinct facial features. He is wearing an ornate garment with a lace ruff, intricate patterns, and a fur shoulder guard. The portrait is framed and features engraved text and a background of fine cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Sir Anthony Shirley, Traveler and Ambassador to Persia
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man wearing armor. He has a beard, mustache, and curly hair and is facing forward. The background includes a shield with a coat of arms above his left shoulder. The setting is plain and cross-hatched, with text below the portrait providing information about the individual.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Shirley
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man, shown in an upper-body portrait while seated. The man has a neutral expression with pronounced features, including a slight double chin and a straight nose. He wears a turban with a cross symbol on top. He is dressed in ornate attire, including a cloak with decorative fastenings and an accessory across his chest. The circular frame around him is heavily decorated. Below the portrait is another scene depicting a group of individuals in various poses and attire. There is Latin text surrounding the main portrait and additional scene. The engraving is on a textured background.

artworks.title: Robert Shirley
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a portrait of a man identified as Robertus Sherley. He is facing slightly towards his left but looking at the viewer. He has a stoic expression with distinct facial features, short hair mostly covered by a large turban, and is dressed in an ornate outfit. The man's hands are visible holding an object. The portrait is surrounded by a decorative frame with Latin text, artistic embellishments, and a smaller oval scene below depicting figures seated around a table or in a room. The background features intricate scrollwork designs.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Shirley, With the Shah of Persian and the Papal Legat
artworks.description: The image features an intricate engraving showing three oval portraits aligned in a triangular layout. The central portrait at the top shows a man with a pointed mustache and a beard, wearing an elaborate turban with ornate details. The two portraits below depict men wearing turbans, each with distinct facial hair. The man on the left has a moustache and is dressed in a patterned coat, while the man on the right sports a fuller beard. Surrounding the portraits are decorative elements, including scrollwork and depictions of armor and weapons on either side of the top portrait. Below the portraits, there is a separate rectangular illustration showing a gathering of men, some seated and wearing ecclesiastical robes, while another figure kneels. This scene is set within an interior space that includes drapery and architectural details, emphasizing a formal communal setting.

artworks.title: Jane Shore
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the upper body up, facing forward with a slight tilt of the head. The person has a smooth complexion, arched eyebrows, and lips curved into a gentle smile. Their hair is styled in tight curls swept back into an updo with a decorative headpiece made of pearls. Two necklaces are visible around the person's neck: one made of pearls and the other intricately designed with floral motifs and a large ornate pendant. The background consists of a simple textured pattern that enhances the focus on the person's hairstyle and jewelry.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Sidney, Lord Deputy of Ireland
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man facing slightly to his right, showing his upper body. The man has a beard, mustache, prominent nose, and sharp eyes. He wears a decorative cap with a plume, a high-collared jacket, ruffled collar, and a beaded necklace. The background has a circular frame with inscriptions and Latin text below the portrait. The image is on paper with visible text on the reverse side.

artworks.title: Sir Henry Sidney, Lord Deputy of Ireland
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body. He is facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the side. The man has a beard and mustache, sharp facial features, short hair covered by a hat with a plume, an ornate collar, a buttoned garment with intricate patterns, and a chain with a medallion around his neck. In the background, there is a detailed oval frame and script at the top and bottom. The image is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney, Soldier and Poet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with a prominent mustache, pointed beard, and wavy hair. He is wearing a draped garment gathered at his left shoulder, and a laurel wreath around his head. The engraving is surrounded by an oval frame with ornate decorations, including winged creatures and scroll motifs. There is a Latin inscription above the oval and additional French text below the portrait. The background features intricate hatching, and the overall design includes decorative embellishments involving foliage and classical designs.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney, Soldier and Poet
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right, with his head turned to look directly at the viewer. He has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, piercing eyes, and a small mustache and beard around his lips. His hair is styled in soft waves, swept back from his face. He is wearing a historical outfit with a large ruffled collar and a richly textured doublet with buttons and embellishments. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with inscribed text and more text below the portrait. The background consists of horizontal lines and the paper has a textured appearance with faint text visible in the backdrop.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney, Soldier and Poet
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This image shows a man in a period-specific outfit with a large ruffled collar, typical of the late 16th to early 17th centuries. He has fine facial features, a pronounced mustache, and wavy hair styled back. The man's attire includes a doublet with intricate embroidery and a sleeveless outer layer. The oval frame surrounding him is inscribed with the name "SYDNEY PHILIPS" and a Latin phrase. The background is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney, Soldier and Poet
artworks.description: The image features Sir Philip Sidney seated outdoors on a rock in a relaxed pose. He has a composed expression, short curly hair under a large hat, and wears an ornate striped doublet and breeches with a lace collar. The setting includes lush greenery, a garden with hedges, a path leading to an architectural estate, and he holds a walking stick. The image is framed by an elaborate border with classical and heraldic motifs.

artworks.title: Sir Philip Sidney, Soldier and Poet
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated against a tree with a sword beside him. He has wavy hair, a wide-brimmed hat, and is dressed in intricate clothing. There is a piece of fabric on a rock beside him. The background features trees, foliage, a building with windows, turret-like structures, and a formal garden with walking figures.

artworks.title: Sigismund Bathori, Prince of Transylvania
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting the upper torso and head of a man in the center of an ornate oval frame. The man has a stern expression, a pointed mustache, and short, curly hair. He wears a detailed garment with patterns and a sash across his chest. On either side of the man are two allegorical female figures; one wearing a helmet and standing on a sphere, the other holding a cornucopia. Both figures seem to support the frame. Above the man is an eagle with outstretched wings holding an olive branch, set against clouds and rays of light. At the base of the frame are two smaller heads facing opposite directions, surrounded by decorative elements. The background is adorned with symbols and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Sigismund III, King of Poland
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait engraving of a man in an elaborate outfit positioned centrally within an oval frame. The man has a mustache, a beard, and short hair, and is depicted facing forward with a composed expression. Two cherubs hold a ribbon with text below the portrait. The frame is surrounded by ornate architectural elements, including carvings and columns. An angelic figure with wings holds a scepter at the top of the frame. Classical statues are placed on either side of the portrait frame, along with engravings and inscriptions in the background.

artworks.title: Sigismund III, King of Poland and Sweden
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up. He is positioned facing slightly to his left, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. The man has delicate facial features with a prominent mustache and a pointed beard. His hair is neatly combed back, revealing a high hairline. He is dressed in elaborate attire with a high, ornate ruff around his neck. His clothing is richly adorned with decorative patterns. The man wears several ornate pieces of ceremonial armor or regalia with detailed, intricate designs, and a sash or belt embellished with complex motifs. The background consists of a decorative oval frame with text, and there is a variety of scrollwork and coat-of-arms motifs along the edges. The bottom of the engraving contains additional text identifying the figure.

artworks.title: Sigismund III, King of Poland
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man with distinctive facial features, including a mustache and a small pointed beard. He is wearing a tall, cylindrical hat with a large plumage, a ruffed collar, and richly patterned clothing. A sword hilt is visible in front of him. The background features an oval border with inscriptions, a crown above, and a heraldic eagle to the right.

artworks.title: Nicolas Brulart, Marquis de Sillery
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is seated or positioned facing the viewer with a dignified posture. The man has an aged face with distinct features such as pronounced wrinkles, a full white beard and mustache, and wavy white hair. He is wearing a high-collared garment under a fur-trimmed cloak or coat. There are no visible items in his hands. The background has a textured pattern with a rectangular tab in the top right corner, and the lower part of the image displays some Latin text.

artworks.title: Nicolas Brulart, Marquis de Sillery
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, facing forward, with his chest, shoulders, and head visible. He has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard. His hair is wavy and framing his face. He is wearing a high-collared garment with fur trim, buttons, folds, and a decorative clasp at the neck. The background is a simple, textured monochrome. Below the man's image, there is text in a serifed font.

artworks.title: Josias Simler
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man's upper body facing forward with his head slightly tilted to the left. He has a long, wavy beard and mustache, furrowed brow, and wears a hat with a narrow, curved brim. His attire includes a cloak or coat with a thick fur collar. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines, and there is Latin text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Sydrach Simpson, Preacher
artworks.description: The image shows a man in clerical attire from a three-quarter view. He has distinct facial features, including a mustache and goatee, curly hair partially covered by a cap, and is holding a small book. He is posed with his left hand on his chest and his right hand holding the book. The man wears a dark robe with a large white collar and cuffs typical of 17th-century clerical attire. In the background, there is a draped curtain on the left side. Below the portrait, there is text identifying the man as "Mr. Sydrach Simpson" with details about his roles and the book's printer.

artworks.title: William Slater, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. The man is depicted facing forward but with his head slightly turned to the left. He has deep-set eyes, a pointed nose, a long beard, a mustache, and receding hair. He is wearing a dark garment with a white ruff collar. The background has a textured, cross-hatched pattern. An inscription below the portrait identifies the subject as "The true Portraiture of the Learned, Mr. William Slater D.D."

artworks.title: Hendrick Daniels Slatius, Preacher
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up, positioned facing forward with a serious expression. He has a full beard and mustache, and short, slightly wavy hair parted to the side. He wears a high-collared garment with an elaborate ruff around his neck. The oval frame around him is intricately designed with scrollwork and two serpents. Also visible are a small image of a bearded face at the top and a depiction of an open book with the text "Liber Seditiosor" at the bottom. The background features parallel line shading typical of engraved portraits.
